profiles.name: derekldavis
profiles.profile: This is a guy whose ball-striking keeps kicking him in the shins and then asking for a raise. The pattern is brutally consistent: the tee ball goes sideways, the irons don’t bail him out, and the short game mostly shows up to collect parking tickets. Even when the putter offers the tiniest mercy, the rest of the bag is already in the ditch. He can stay afloat on the board because the field is also a crime scene, but the golf itself is basically one long emergency call from the cart barn.
